episodes.synopsis: Mizusawa Chisato works at a PR firm, and is a calm and cool office lady, at least so her coworkers think, but Chisato has a hidden side to her. When she drinks, she acts extremely cute. One day, a junior at her office named Koharu asks her for help, and invites Chisato to drink, but Chisato turns her down...
episodes.title: Plum Splet

episodes.synopsis: As Chisato and Sora are spending a day off at home for the first time in a while, the weather turns bad, and Chisato tries to convince Sora not to go out shopping despite the sad state of their refrigerator...
episodes.title: Tangerine Breeze

episodes.synopsis: Chisato tries to hang the winged Lemon Man that Koharu gave her from the ceiling at work, but she falls off the stepladder and sprains her ankle.
episodes.title: Cinderella

episodes.synopsis: Chisato is too hungry to sleep after watching a cooking show late at night, so Sora sets about cooking for her.
episodes.title: Spritzer

episodes.synopsis: Chisato swears off liquor and works overtime every day as an important deadline draws near... but the exhaustion and absence of drinking from her routine quickly leads to withdrawal!
episodes.title: Special Banana Cocktail

episodes.synopsis: Shiraishi Yui is Chisato's colleague who sees her as a rival. She becomes depressed when Chisato's proposal for a new PR job is approved, so Chisato invites her out for dinner.
episodes.title: Bellini

episodes.synopsis: Chisato and Sora are spending Sunday afternoon at home when they come across a horror film on TV that entrances Sora.
episodes.title: Irish Coffee

episodes.synopsis: One winter day, Chisato is confused when she returns from work and Sora doesn't immediately greet her. She then finds Sora wearing a flu mask...
episodes.title: Egg Sake

episodes.synopsis: Sora sees Chisato off with a hug, telling her that a 30-second hug is enough to make a person feel better. At the office, Chisato sees Yui sighing in exhaustion, so she calls her to the break room...
episodes.title: Zoom

episodes.synopsis: Chisato receives an April Fool's message from Sora saying, "Help me!" She returns home to find a stuffed animal in an apron on the table, but Sora is nowhere to be found...
episodes.title: Shandygaff

episodes.synopsis: Koharu brings Chisato to a bar called "No Rest," telling her that non-alcoholic cocktails can be good, too. When they set foot inside, they find Sora behind the bar, filling in for the sick owner.
episodes.title: Rainy Night

episodes.synopsis: Chisato visits the bar "No Rest," where she first met Sora, with Yui and Koharu and drinks only non-alcoholic cocktails in front of them. Then as Sora, who was bartending that evening, starts to walk Chisato home...
episodes.title: First Time

episodes.synopsis: It's Friday, and Chisato watches her colleagues go out for drinks after work, her own head already filling with thoughts of alcohol. She's a bit disappointed when she returns home to see Sora's homemade curry and a non-alcoholic yogurt smoothie waiting for her... until Sora pulls up his special menu.
episodes.title: Frozen Mango Cocktail
